description: nwp_drinkwater is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geo.rijkswaterstaat.nl. This file contains the map layers used for map 14 ‘Drinkwater’ in the National Water Programme 2022-2027. The maps in the National Water Programme are drawn up as printed maps at A4 level and have only been checked and established at this level. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal shows the English title as "nwp _drinking water" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include nationaal water programma, nwp. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
